messages.subject: semTools 0.5-4 available from CRAN
parts:
The latest semTools update is a maintenance version, but fixes many major bugs that led to incorrect results from reliability(), probe2WayMC(), and probe2WayRC(), as well as emmeans for models with incomplete data and fitMeasures() for lavaan.mi objects.

https://github.com/simsem/semTools/blob/master/semTools/NEWS.md

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
